'''Promotional Foils''' are 28 foil reprints of earlier commons, uncommons, and two rares ([[Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber]] and [[Darth Maul With Lightsaber]]). Decipher gave them to tournament winners and a random participant, as retailer/distributor incentives, as wrapper redemptions, and as DecipherCon / championship prizes. They are '''not''' Reflections pack foils. A foil of a title on this list can be authentic even if it is not on the [[Reflections]], [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]], [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III]], or [[Endor]] foil lists.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

Tournament directors typically awarded one card to the winner and one to a random participant. Each title was in the program for about two months; a new card rotated in and an old one rotated out, usually alternating Light and Dark so one of each was available. After the program ended, leftover copies were still used as prize support without the original schedule.<ref name="encyc" />

== Possible foils ==

=== Light Side ===
[[A Few Maneuvers]], [[Alter]], [[Battle Plan]], [[Clash Of Sabers]], [[Corellian Corvette]], [[Grimtaash]], [[Houjix]], [[Insurrection]], [[It Could Be Worse]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber]], [[Rebel Barrier]], [[Sense]], [[Snowspeeder]], [[The Signal]]

=== Dark Side ===
[[Alter]], [[Battle Order]], [[Dark Maneuvers]], [[Darth Maul With Lightsaber]], [[Ghhhk]], [[Imperial Arrest Order]], [[Imperial Barrier]], [[Imperial Decree]], [[Imperial-Class Star Destroyer]], [[Masterful Move]], [[Monnok]], [[Sense]], [[Twi'lek Advisor]], [[You Are Beaten]]

== Programs ==
Encyclopedia 3.2 groups the same 28 titles by how they were given out (some titles appear in more than one program):<ref name="encyc" />

* '''DecipherCon 2000 pre-registration:''' [[Corellian Corvette]], [[Imperial-Class Star Destroyer]]
* '''Battle of Endor closed tournament:''' [[A Few Maneuvers]], [[Dark Maneuvers]]
* '''Episode I closed tournament:''' [[Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber]]
* '''Monthly tournament foils''' (2001–2002 rotation): [[Masterful Move]], [[The Signal]], [[Imperial Decree]], [[Alter]] (Light), [[Sense]], [[Snowspeeder]], [[Twi'lek Advisor]], [[It Could Be Worse]], [[Imperial Arrest Order]], [[Insurrection]], [[Alter]] (Dark), [[Ghhhk]], [[Sense]] (Dark), [[Grimtaash]], [[Houjix]], [[Monnok]]
* '''2000 State Champion binder:''' exclusive binder; runners-up received [[Corellian Corvette]] in place of [[Imperial-Class Star Destroyer]]
* '''2001 World Championship Open Qualifier''' (top 75 at each open): [[Rebel Barrier]]
* '''Wrapper redemption''' (30 wrappers of a named set): [[You Are Beaten]] (Death Star II), [[Imperial Barrier]] (Reflections II; also with a Reflections box from Decipher's store), [[Masterful Move]]
* '''Distributor / retailer case incentive:''' [[Imperial Barrier]], [[Clash Of Sabers]], [[Imperial-Class Star Destroyer]], [[You Are Beaten]], [[Masterful Move]], [[The Signal]], [[Battle Plan]], [[Battle Order]], [[Darth Maul With Lightsaber]]
